title: Shape artist · Level 1: A square that closes
brief: The class robot starts in the middle of an empty 2400 x 2400 mm floor facing +x (starts vary 20 mm and 5 degrees); the level fixes the robot. The pen is the middle of the axle. The run ends when the program ends, or at 60 s. Draw a square of 400 mm sides. The closing error is the distance from where the pen starts to where it ends. 50 points for drawing every side without touching a wall (the pen travels 90 % of the perimeter and the trail encloses 80 % of its area), plus 40 for the close (all 40 at a closing error of 10 mm or less, 40 x 10 / error above), plus 10 for ending within 2 degrees of the start heading. A run that does not draw every side scores 0. Pass: mean 60 or more over 5 runs, 4 of them finishing (every side drawn, no wall touched). Par error: 10 mm.

score.run: if(trailLength >= 0.9 * perim & pieceArea_1 >= 0.8 * area1, let e = pieceClose_1 in round(if(touches == 0, 50, 0) + if(e <= parErr, 40, 40 * parErr / e) + if(abs(wrap180(endHeading - startHeading)) <= headDeg, 10, 0), 1), 0)

finished.value: count(r in runs: r.trailLength >= 0.9 * perim & r.pieceArea_1 >= 0.8 * area1 & r.touches == 0)
